Detailed Description

Runtime representation of a loaded .superdex_scene.

Owns the physics scene and provides named lookup for bots, controllers, sensors, actuators, and spawnable prefabs. This is NOT a prefab — it composes data from both mochi_physics and mochi_bots.

◆ GetOrLoadSpawnableBot()

Bot * superdex::robotics::BotScene::GetOrLoadSpawnableBot ( std::string_view name,
superdex::Error & error )

Get (loading on first use) a bot for a spawnable prefab whose path is a .superdex_bot_archive / .superdex_bot, by the name declared in the .superdex_scene file's spawnablePrefabs.

Unlike SpawnPrefabInstance (which places a named instance), this instantiates the spawnable once per name as an articulated Bot (CreateBot) so callers can access its articulated actor (e.g. for FK). The bot is created at identity root; callers that need placement set the actor pose themselves. Cached per name and owned by this BotScene. Returns nullptr and sets error if the name is unknown or its prefab is not a bot archive.

Parameters
[in]nameSpawnable-prefab name declared in this scene.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Cached or newly instantiated articulated bot, or None on error.

◆ SpawnPrefabInstance() [2/2]

Span< ActorHandle const > superdex::robotics::BotScene::SpawnPrefabInstance ( std::string_view instanceName,
std::string_view prefabName,
TransformRT const & worldFromInstance,
superdex::Error & error )

Spawn a spawnable prefab under an instance name at a world pose.

Instances are keyed by instance name, not prefab name, so the same prefab may be spawned any number of times. The instance name prefixes the created actor names, and is the identity the rest of the pipeline keys off (the recorded HDF5 object id and the dataset/replay feature key; see SpawnEntry::name). The instance does not replace the scene's gravity or solver settings. A .superdex_bot / .superdex_bot_archive spawnable is instantiated as an articulated Bot named after the instance and rooted at worldFromInstance; the instance owns it.

Parameters
[in]instanceNameUnique, non-empty instance name; must not already be live.
[in]prefabNameSpawnable-prefab name declared in this scene.
[in]worldFromInstanceInstance root pose in world space.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
Actor handles in prefab AddToScene order (for a bot, its articulated actor), or empty on error. Valid until the instance is destroyed.

friend

Load a bot scene into a caller-provided scene from an already-loaded prefab.

Like LoadBotScene(std::string_view, Context*, RoboticsContext*, superdex::Error&) but does not create or own the scene: bots and controllers are created in scene and the base prefab (already loaded and path-resolved, e.g. by an asset) is added directly. The returned BotScene destroys the bots and controllers it created but leaves scene intact (the caller retains ownership of the scene).

Parameters
[in]sceneCaller-owned scene to populate.
[in]prefabAlready-loaded, path-resolved bot scene parameters.
[in]rootPathRoot directory used to resolve the base scene's relative shape/prefab paths.
[in]contextMochi context.
[in]botsCtxRoboticsContext for controller creation and lifetime management.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
The loaded BotScene (non-owning of scene).

BotScene LoadBotScene ( Scene * scene,
std::string_view path,
Context * context,
RoboticsContext * botsCtx,
superdex::Error & error )
friend

Load a bot scene into a caller-provided scene from a file or archive path.

Like the prefab overload but loads and validates the BotScenePrefab through LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile so archive extraction remains transparent. The base-scene-relative root is derived analogously to the path overload (bots root with a resolved base-scene fallback), then delegates to the prefab overload. The returned BotScene owns the bots, controllers, and base-scene actors it added but leaves the caller-owned Scene intact.

Parameters
[in]sceneCaller-owned scene to populate.
[in]pathFile path to the .superdex_scene file or .superdex_scene_archive.
[in]contextMochi context.
[in]botsCtxRoboticsContext for controller creation and lifetime management.
[in,out]errorError status. Check Error::IsOK for success.
Returns
The loaded BotScene (non-owning of scene).

DynamicArray< DynamicString > const & bots,

Like LoadBotScene(std::string_view, Context*, RoboticsContext*, superdex::Error&), but instantiates only the declared bots named in bots, each with its edit in edits set in its prefab before the bot is created, e.g.

to rebuild the bots a recording was made with. edits is a JSON object of DiffPrefab results by bot name, or empty for none. The rest stay declared, and BotScene::InitializeBot brings them up unedited. Errors if bots names a bot the scene does not declare, or an edit is for a bot not in bots or does not fit its bot.
